import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    s = int(data[2]) - 1
    t = int(data[3])

    # First while loop: reduce t until divisible by n
    while t % n != 0:
        if s < m:
            s = (s + t) % n
        else:
            s = (s - t) % n
        t -= 1
    t //= n

    seen = [-1] * n
    seen[s] = 0
    count = 0
    while t > 0:
        t -= 1
        count += 1
        for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
            if s < m:
                s = (s + i) % n
            else:
                s = (s - i) % n
        if seen[s] != -1:
            t %= (count - seen[s])
        seen[s] = count

    print(s + 1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
